\caption{State-level projections of cervical cancer incidence and mortality under a single-round HPV DNA testing programme at 70\% coverage, by region, at three snapshot years. Observed rates are the 2012--19 means of the population-based cancer registry estimates used for calibration (ICMR-NINE); projected rates are per 100{,}000 women. Reductions are relative to no screening in the same year. First year CIR $<$ 4 is the first calendar year in which the mean CIR falls below 4 per 100{,}000 (the proxy for the WHO elimination threshold used in this study) at 70\% coverage (-- = not reached by 2070). States are ordered within region by projected no-screening CIR in 2026. India row: dedicated national model; state rows: independently calibrated state models (1000 simulations each). The 2050 values also appear in Table~1 of the main text, beside those for VIA and Pap cytology. CIR=crude incidence rate. CMR=crude mortality rate.}
